subject: Re: MAP runway cordon and derisk proposal
messages:
From: Susan Wu <susan.wu@arcadia-analytics.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procure@arcadia-analytics.com
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft and close cadence concerns

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about the latency numbers and the cost projection for our forecasting workload. Before we commit to a go-live window, procurement asked me to send a short MAP (attached) and call out risk areas that could push our close past the planned 12/15 target.

High-level risks we flagged while reviewing:
- Procurement sign-off lag (vendor security review queue)
- Integration testing window (we expect two integration blockers in week-long sprints)
- SOC2 evidence gap for one of our compliance checkboxes

Can you confirm Redwood's proposed mitigation steps and a failover cadence if we hit a procurement delay? We want something we can present to our CFO and legal with clear triggers.

Attachments: Arcadia_MAP_v3.xlsx

Best,
Susan Wu
Senior Procurement Manager
Arcadia Analytics

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Susan Wu <susan.wu@arcadia-analytics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-02T10:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and close cadence concerns

Susan — thanks for the note and the MAP. I reviewed the attachment and sketched an operational cordon we can run if the procurement window slips. Summary below, full runbook attached on Drive (link included in metadata).

Quick proposal (for your execs):
1) Procurement delay < 2 weeks: Redwood provides a temporary hosted seat allocation (no long-term commitment) and a documented SLA for data isolation. We absorb marginal cost for the first two weeks.
2) Delay between 2–6 weeks: We offer a canary cut with limited capacity + a phased billing holdback tied to defined acceptance gates.
3) Delay > 6 weeks: Escalation to enterprise sales for contract acceleration + option to reserve Dedicated capacity with a short-term credit to bridge acceptance.

Mitigations we can commit to today:
- SOC2 evidence: we can produce a scoped snapshot (SOC2_snapshot.pdf) within 48 hours and open a joint evidence review.
- Integration testing: assign a Redwood test engineer (Priyom) as a liaison for the first two sprints.
- Governance triggers: define three MAP triggers (Procurement queued, QA failure > 2 sprints, Acceptance window slip) that automatically shift to the next mitigation tier.

I'll put the formal cordon + a short risk heatmap in a one-pager and loop Rishi for pricing guardrails.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Susan Wu <susan.wu@arcadia-analytics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-04T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and close cadence concerns

Susan / Laura — adding pricing and commercial guardrails. Short answers:

- Temporary hosted seat allocation (Tier 1): Redwood will cover up to $5k in hosting credits for the first 14 days if procurement is still in review, provided Arcadia signs the MAP acknowledgement (sheet 1 of the attachment) within 72 hours.
- Canary cut (Tier 2): We can offer a 25% trial discount on the first two months of Dedicated consumption during the phased cut, plus a billing holdback tied to acceptance gates.
- Acceleration option (Tier 3): If timeline slips beyond 6 weeks and Arcadia still intends to proceed, we can price-lock an offer for Dedicated capacity for 90 days at the quoted rate.

I attached a simple contingency pricing table (runway-risk-heatmap.png) and noted the trigger conditions. Laura — Priyom will coordinate the integration liaison. Priyom, can you confirm availability for the week of Nov 8?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Susan Wu <susan.wu@arcadia-analytics.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP runway cordon and derisk proposal

Susan — quick operational reply. I'm available to act as Arcadia's integration liaison the weeks of Nov 8 and Nov 15. Proposed short checklist for the integration sprint:

- Day 0: kickoff call (30m) with Arcadia devs and Redwood infra team.
- Day 1–3: baseline connectivity + auth (verify KMS and VPC routes).
- Day 4–7: streaming tests and KV cache behavior checks with your sample dataset (we'll use subset A from your attachment).
- Day 8–14: acceptance smoke runs, capture latency/throughput metrics and sign-off gate.

If procurement confirms before the second smoke run, we proceed to the full MAP acceptance. If procurement remains pending after Day 14, we'll execute the Tier 1 hosted seat and start billing-holdback triggers per Rishi's notes.

Forwarding a short HTML summary to your procurement alias so the triggers are explicit.

Attachments referenced inline: SOC2_snapshot.pdf, Arcadia_MAP_v3.xlsx

—Priyom
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
